fields.title: Find where RAG breaks
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: For each symptom, state at which step the problem lies.
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/0: Ingredient answer is incomplete, cuts off mid-list
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/1: Asking 'got anything cheaper?' retrieves random items
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/2: Products from another city get into the context
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/3: Correct item found, answer is wrong
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1 — chunking: document cut right through ingredients. 2 — query transformation: pronoun without dialogue context. 3 — missing pre-search filtering by available stores. 4 — generation: instruction or model, rarest case. Technique: start with the log of what made it into context — four out of five cases are visible instantly.
